name: Free Owner Admin [Abuse]
desc:
This gives you the highest rank possible in HD admin. You are allowed to abuse but if someone asks you to stop please stop.

Hope you have fun in Free Owner Admin [Abuse]!

Please do not abuse ban commands if you ever get them because some people reflect it on the game and think it is the creators/developers who are at fault for it. 

Thanks to the people who unban everyone!

This is like [Free Admin] but it is with owner admin.

If you tell the developers/creators that our game is trash we do not take offense to it at all we just ignore it since we are working on different things other than an admin game.
